description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Ignis (Fire)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Ignis (Fire)
description.text: Increases [Fire Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Ignis (Fire) after another ally uses a Fire, Ice or Lightning ability targeting that ally (max 6), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Sagefire+
description.text: Four single attacks (1.00) each, grants [Buff Fire 10% (15s)] to the user every second activation

description.name: Enhancement+
description.text: Six single ranged attacks (1.25 each), capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Quick Recipe+
description.text: Transfers the user's Soul Break points to the target (maximum of 500 Soul Break points), grants [Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Ignis
description.text: Grants [Buff Fire +10% (5s)], [Buff Lightning +10% (5s)], [Buff Earth +10% (5s)] and [Physical Quick Cast 1] to the ally that triggered the chase

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
